page: Microsoft Azure L80as_v5 is a member of the Lasv5 server family, utilizing dedicated AMD processors built on the x86_64 architecture. This virtualized instance runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor and features 80 dedicated vCPUs. It is equipped with 640.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 8.0 GB of RAM per core.

The instance includes 19199 GB of local storage and is Premium Storage capable, allowing for high-throughput local data access. It does not feature any integrated graphics processing units, making it reliant entirely on CPU-based execution. No complimentary public IPv4 addresses are bundled with this configuration.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the high density of both local storage and memory relative to the 80 dedicated vCPUs positions this instance for data-intensive workloads. The lack of hardware acceleration limits its utility for deep learning, but the substantial local storage capacity and memory footprint make it appropriate for large-scale databases, big data analytics, and memory-intensive enterprise applications.
